show.description: Hardik Goyal’s perfect life collapses when he loses his company, reputation, and fiancée overnight. Betrayed and broken, fate pulls him into the shadowy world of the mafia, where power replaces principles. As danger escalates, Hardik reconnects with Niharika, his childhood savior, discovering love, strength, and destiny. Choosing the mafia becomes his only way to protect love, family, and his future.
